races.name: Tynedale Agricultural Society Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Artiste d'Ainay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 666-day layoff creates significant fitness concerns despite previous ability over hurdles.
runners_data.comment: Reverts to hurdles on the back of a point win and on a workable mark; interesting.
runners_data.spotlight: 2-12 in points but took ten attempts to add to his maiden success, though had earlier shown a fair level of ability over hurdles; returns to this sphere after last month's easy point win, after which he was purchased for £10,000; worth considering off a workable mark back over hurdles on stable debut.

runners_data.name: Jeteye
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with proven C&D form, 27-day break should leave him spot-on for this assignment.
runners_data.comment: Reappearance was encouraging but a lesser effort since tempers enthusiasm.
runners_data.spotlight: 2024 C&D winner; promising third when returning from a 15-month absence at Wetherby (3m, good) in March, in this headgear combination, proving he retains a good chunk of his ability; however, he'll need to quickly bounce back from a lesser effort at Perth last time, which tempers enthusiasm.

runners_data.name: Dillarchie
runners_data.note: Strong staying prominent runner in excellent current form but disappointed last time off this exact mark.
runners_data.comment: Solid claims if recapturing the level of form she showed earlier in the year.
runners_data.spotlight: Strong stayer who notched up three wins from February to April, though took a backward step last time over C&D off this mark; however, she's not out of this if repeating previous efforts with Oscar Palmer taking a valuable 3lb off her back.

runners_data.name: Shighness
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who shaped well returning to hurdles at Sedgefield, 55-day break potentially sharpening her up.
runners_data.comment: On a handy mark and back to some form on last hurdles start so hard to rule out.
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't won for a couple of years and that was over fences, but she shaped encouragingly reverting to hurdles when third at Sedgefield (3m3f, soft) in February, albeit beaten nearly 19l, and has fallen back over fences since; however, she's on a handy mark and is hard to dismiss.

runners_data.name: Valette
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with modest hurdle form, tongue-tie addition suggests connections seeking improvement.
runners_data.comment: Has offered little more than modest form on all hurdle starts, including on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Has offered little more than modest form in four runs over hurdles and was beaten 25l from 1lb higher on handicap debut last month; now fitted with a tongue-tie but others make more obvious appeal.

runners_data.name: East Eagle
runners_data.note: Reliable hold-up horse in consistent form, strong finisher who handles testing ground conditions well.
runners_data.comment: Failed to land a blow over C&D latest and may find this mark demanding, but not out of it.
runners_data.spotlight: Reliable 6yo who has continued in good heart since scoring at Catterick (3m1f, good) in January and produced a career-best when back on the scoresheet at Stratford (3m2f, good) last month; failed to land a blow over C&D latest and has something to find with My Boy Christy, though he remains one for the shortlist in the context of the race.

runners_data.name: Reagrove Lord
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 400-day absence with new headgear combination after disappointing recent efforts.
runners_data.comment: Returns from an absence with major questions to answer.
runners_data.spotlight: Has produced a couple of fair efforts in defeat, including a 10l third over C&D in this headgear combination in December 2024, but subsequent runs were disappointing; returns from a lengthy absence with major questions to answer.

runners_data.name: Twoplacesatonetime
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent form is underwhelming, unseated rider last time creates confidence concerns.
runners_data.comment: Form prior to unseating latest was underwhelming which leaves him with plenty to prove.
runners_data.spotlight: Unseated rider in March when last seen, but his form prior to that was underwhelming and he returns with plenty to prove at present.

runners_data.name: Watchoutitscookie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven class at this level, consistency issues but dangerous if reproducing recent Exeter third.
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent, but a leading player if reproducing his latest third at Exeter last month.
runners_data.spotlight: 2m4f hurdle and 2m7f chase winner (both good to soft); has struggled with consistency, but a leading player if reproducing his latest third of eight at Exeter last month.

runners_data.name: Seeyainthesuninn
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden improving with each run, 1lb drop in weights could prove significant for progressive type.
runners_data.comment: Produced best effort yet last time and he's one to consider if backing it up.
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden over hurdles but produced his best effort yet when third at Perth (2m4f, good) latest; 1lb lower now and he's one to consider if able to back that up.

runners_data.name: Bray Dale
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer struggling in handicap company, new visor suggests trainer seeking spark but heavy recent defeats concern.
runners_data.comment: Arrives here after a couple of heavy defeats and has lots to prove.
runners_data.spotlight: Made an encouraging start to handicap company last March but has failed to progress since and arrives here after a couple of heavy defeats; lots to prove.

runners_data.name: My Boy Christy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner twice placed recently over course, improving profile and only 1lb higher than last success attempt.
runners_data.comment: Only 1lb higher than when a solid second over C&D last time; leading contender.
runners_data.spotlight: Went close to shedding the maiden tag when runner-up over 2m4f here and backed that up with another solid second over C&D 17 days ago; only 1lb higher and the booking of William Maggs catches the eye, so he looks a leading contender.

races.paceDynamic: Jeteye is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting an even gallop without pressure through the early stages. Prominent runners Artiste d'Ainay, Dillarchie, and Watchoutitscookie will track close behind, but none are natural pace-pressers. The large field of hold-up horses including Shighness, East Eagle, and My Boy Christy will be content to settle towards the rear. This sets up a classic scenario where the front-runner controls the tempo unchallenged until the closing stages, strongly favoring those who can either stay close to the pace or possess exceptional finishing kick from midfield.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jeteye Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Jeteye maintains his advantage turning for home and the hold-up brigade leave their runs too late.
scenarios.body: The 2024 C&D winner has proven stamina reserves and tactical speed to quicken when challenged. His recent Wetherby third suggests retained ability after the layoff, and controlling the tempo suits his front-running style perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly steady and allows the back-markers to unleash sustained finishing kicks.
scenarios.body: East Eagle and My Boy Christy both possess strong finishing speed and have shown their best form when allowed to come from behind. The soft ground will aid their stamina reserves in a staying finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can stay close enough to Jeteye while retaining finishing power.
scenarios.body: Dillarchie's recent hat-trick proves her current well-being, and her strong staying power makes her dangerous if within striking range. Watchoutitscookie has the class edge if reproducing his Exeter third.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Jeteye weakens before the home turn after his 27-day break and extended absence.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where natural speed matters more than tactical positioning. This would suit horses with turn of foot regardless of their usual running style.

watchPoints.text: Jeteye's jumping under pressure in the home straight as he's been off 27 days and could tire if his recent Wetherby effort flattered.
Dillarchie's handling of the drop back in trip from her recent longer distance successes to this 2m7½f assignment.
East Eagle's ability to secure the strong pace he needs from his hold-up position given Jeteye's likely uncontested lead.
Any market support for Reagrove Lord given his 400-day absence but previous course form and weight advantage.
My Boy Christy's positioning in the early stages as he's been prominent recently but usually races from behind.

races.name: Port Of Blyth Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Dream Jet
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 159-day break faces fitness concerns despite strong course record
runners_data.comment: Usually needs a run under his belt to hit form after a break but has a decent record here.
runners_data.spotlight: Has a decent record here (231413) but usually needs a run under his belt to hit form after a break; this will be his first run of the year but his course record means he cannot be ignored.

runners_data.name: Chapel Green
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter whose recent third gives him fitness edge over most rivals despite moderate recent form
runners_data.comment: Won over 2m5f at Kelso last September but rather disappointing since.
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 2m5f at Kelso following a 163-day break last September (good) but rather disappointing since; on a good mark now, but a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Conquer The Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage but recent C&D win on similar ground shows current ability
runners_data.comment: Well supported when landing his second success over C&D on his stable debut ten days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Well supported when landing his second C&D success (good to soft) on his stable debut ten days ago following a five-month break; 8lb rise may not be enough to stop him going in again.

runners_data.name: Diamond Mix
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits pace setup but 66-day absence may leave him short of peak fitness
runners_data.comment: Dual C&D winner who should strip fitter following a decent third at Newcastle in March.
runners_data.spotlight: Dual C&D winner who should strip fitter following a decent third at Newcastle (2m, good to soft) in March; still lightly raced with the promise of more improvement to come.

runners_data.name: Raffles Wonder
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 58-day break with stable switch complicating assessment
runners_data.comment: Won twice over fences last year for Rebecca Menzies but four lesser runs since.
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over fences last year for Rebecca Menzies but four lesser runs since have seen him slip down to his last winning mark; has switched stables since his last run in March and any significant move in the market should be noted.

runners_data.name: Don Occhetti
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose form has declined since yard switch and faces wrong tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: Has been below form for this yard this year following a lengthy absence.
runners_data.spotlight: Scored for Dan Skelton in August 2024 but has been below form for this yard this year following a lengthy absence; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Chumlee
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran returning from 110-day break with poor recent fence record makes him hard to fancy
runners_data.comment: Never threatened on his completed starts over fences last season.
runners_data.spotlight: 11yo who is lightly raced for his age; never threatened on his completed starts over fences last season (fell early latest); is a dual hurdle winner but suspicion he might prove vulnerable to some of the much younger legs in this line-up.

races.paceDynamic: Chapel Green appears the most natural early leader with his prominent style and recent form showing front-running tendencies. Dream Jet may also press forward early given his prominent preference, creating a modest pace through the early stages. The majority of the field (Conquer The Breeze, Raffles Wonder, Don Occhetti, Chumlee) are hold-up horses who will settle towards the rear, meaning limited early pressure on the leaders. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners and those with early pace, as they can dictate terms without being harried in a race where most horses want to come from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate completely
scenarios.trigger: If Chapel Green and Dream Jet get an uncontested lead and maintain a sustainable gallop
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows them to save energy for a strong finish while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing ground. The prominent pair can kick clear approaching the final fence before the majority get into their stride.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Form horse strikes late
scenarios.trigger: If Conquer The Breeze reproduces his recent C&D winning form despite the unfavourable pace scenario
scenarios.body: His class and fitness advantage from that impressive ten-day-ago victory allows him to overcome the tactical disadvantage and reel in tiring leaders. Diamond Mix could also benefit from a similar late surge given his dual C&D winning record.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Chapel Green and Dream Jet fail to fire leaving no genuine pace in the race
scenarios.body: The crawling early gallop turns into a sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of running style. This creates chaos where outsiders like the returning Raffles Wonder or even Don Occhetti could capitalise on the tactical mess.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fitness tells decisive story
scenarios.trigger: If the returning horses Dream Jet and Raffles Wonder show their lengthy breaks too keenly
scenarios.body: Their rustiness becomes apparent in the closing stages allowing the recently raced Conquer The Breeze and Diamond Mix to assert superiority. Chapel Green's more recent run gives him a decisive edge over the absentees in a tight finish.

watchPoints.text: Chapel Green and Dream Jet could steal this if they get soft early fractions with the field playing into their hands
Conquer The Breeze needs to overcome tactical disadvantage but his recent C&D form makes him the main threat to leaders
Diamond Mix's dual C&D winning record means he cannot be dismissed despite recent absence
Dream Jet's 159-day break is a significant concern even with his excellent course record
The hold-up majority (four horses) creates an unusual tactical dynamic that could backfire spectacularly

races.name: Port Of Blyth Novices' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Passengerontheship
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but pulled up over 3m here last time and still seeking first win under rules despite recent placed efforts
runners_data.comment: Pulled up here 17 days ago on second chase start in first-time tongue-tie (retained).
runners_data.spotlight: Second in three hurdles in early 2025 but is still 0-10 under rules; pulled up here (3m, good) 17 days ago on second chase start in first-time tongue-tie (retained); the jury is out at present.

runners_data.name: Scairp Dubh
runners_data.note: Won over course and distance 17 days ago but hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage with likely slow early pace
runners_data.comment: Won over hurdles at Carlisle in February and won on chase debut over C&D 17 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark over hurdles at Carlisle in February and made a winning chase debut over C&D (good) 17 days ago; only four of the 13 managed to complete but a 3lb rise may not be enough to stop him following up.

runners_data.name: Gone With The Tide
runners_data.note: Prominent runner completely out of form and making chase debut, but trainer Alison Hamilton has 50% strike rate recently
runners_data.comment: 0-10 over hurdles and out of sorts since returning last November.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles and out of sorts since returning last November; beaten 35l at Perth last month in first-time cheekpieces which are retained here on chase debut; hard to make a case for.

runners_data.name: Lewa House
runners_data.note: Key pace angle as only front-runner, returning after 55-day break with first-time tongue-tie and visor but has course form
runners_data.comment: Runner-up off 3lb higher over C&D last March but unable to recapture that form since.
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up off 3lb higher over C&D (good to soft) last March but unable to recapture that form across his five starts last season; wears first-time tongue-tie/visor (replacing cheekpieces).

runners_data.name: Out On Her Own
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner on chase debut wearing first-time hood, placed in last three hurdle starts but faces pace scenario
runners_data.comment: 0-9 under rules but has been placed in her last three starts over hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-9 under rules but has been placed in her last three starts over hurdles; sports first-time hood on chase debut and interesting if she carries on the momentum in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Reliance Kid
runners_data.note: Struggling hold-up runner who tends to fade in finish, well beaten here last time and has shown little under rules
runners_data.comment: Well beaten at 33-1 here on his second chase start last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Went close in a point in May 2024 but he's struggled under rules and was well beaten at 33-1 here (3m, good) on his second chase start last month.

runners_data.name: Tell Me Again
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making stable debut after unseating early in Scairp Dubh's recent course win, needs to complete first
runners_data.comment: Unseated early on in race won by Scairp Dubh over C&D 17 days ago on stable debut.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 under rules; third in a couple of Irish points in October; unseated early on in race won by Scairp Dubh over C&D 17 days ago on stable debut; needs a completion in order to assess.

races.paceDynamic: Lewa House is the only confirmed front-runner in this small field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure from the predominantly hold-up oriented field. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will likely be steady rather than searching, with Gone With The Tide potentially tracking in second but five others content to sit off the pace. Scairp Dubh, Tell Me Again, Out On Her Own and Passengerontheship will all be looking to come from behind in the closing stages. This tactical setup strongly favours the front-runner Lewa House, as he can dictate terms without interference and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still getting organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lewa House gets an easy lead and times his effort correctly.
scenarios.body: The veteran can control the race from the front without pressure, then quicken clear when the hold-up brigade are still finding their rhythm in the soft ground. His course experience and tactical advantage of setting his own fractions makes him very hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and sets up a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: Scairp Dubh's superior class rating (OR 99) and recent winning form allows him to overcome the tactical disadvantage with a strong finishing kick. The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario of a cavalry charge finish where pure ability matters most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Gone With The Tide shows improved form and sits closer to the pace.
scenarios.body: The lightly-weighted mare can stalk Lewa House throughout and strike when he weakens, benefiting from race fitness while avoiding the traffic problems that hold-up horses face. Her prominent style gives her first run on the improving hold-up runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Lewa House stops or makes jumping errors under pressure.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where any of the hold-up horses can capitalize, but the lack of early pace makes it a lottery finish. Whoever gets the clearest run and finds their rhythm first in the closing stages prevails.

watchPoints.text: Lewa House may be rusty after 55-day layoff and could surrender his crucial pace advantage early if not fully tuned up
Gone With The Tide is 0-10 over hurdles and badly out of form, making chase debut a significant unknown despite prominent style
Tell Me Again unseated early last time here and needs to prove he can get around safely before considering his finishing kick
Scairp Dubh faces 17-day turnaround after his course win where only four of 13 completed the race
Out On Her Own wears first-time hood on chase debut and needs to transfer hurdle form to the bigger obstacles

races.name: Lynn Siddall Memorial Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: The Clonmel Kid

runners_data.comment: Has made a decent start over fences, winning at Newcastle last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark on his second start over fences at Newcastle (2m4f, good) last month and wasn't beaten far when last of three at Kelso (2m7f, good) 13 days ago; this looks easier and he shouldn't be far away.

runners_data.name: Kells Priory
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to fences after disappointing hurdles efforts, Murphy's 12/42 strike-rate provides confidence
runners_data.comment: Three runs over hurdles for current yard nothing special but may improve back over fences.
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over hurdles when trained in Ireland; three runs over hurdles for current yard nothing special but may be a different proposition returning to fences with blinkers replacing cheekpieces.

runners_data.note: Lightly-raced and making chase debut, prominent style suits but inexperience over fences is a concern
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner who has run well without winning over hurdles; contender on chase debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner who has run well without winning over hurdles; still lightly raced and there should be more to come from her on her first start over fences.

runners_data.name: Killybegs Jet Lady
runners_data.note: Twice runner-up over course and distance, finally ready to break her 0-15 maiden tag with tactical knowledge

runners_data.name: Dr Shirocco
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran who ran creditably third here last time, but at 11 may lack the pace of younger rivals
runners_data.comment: Showed there was still fire in the tank when third over C&D 17 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran without a win since November 2024 but showed there was still fire in the tank when third over C&D 17 days ago; younger rivals may have his measure here, however.

runners_data.name: Don Brocco
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor recent form, needs everything to fall right from his patient racing style
runners_data.comment: 1-20 over fences; requires an extreme test to be seen at his best.
runners_data.spotlight: 1-20 over fences and although he finished second here (4m) in March, he has run below that since at Carlisle and back over hurdles at Perth; requires an extreme test to be seen at his best.

runners_data.name: West Lawn
runners_data.note: Struggling hold-up mare who is 9lb wrong in the handicap and has failed twice recently over course and distance
runners_data.comment: 0-19 over fences and has struggled in her last two starts, both over C&D.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-19 over fences and has struggled in her last two starts, both over C&D; being 9lb wrong in the handicap doesn't help.

runners_data.name: Milan Milos
runners_data.note: Won on chase debut at Plumpton, tongue-tie retained but hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage here
runners_data.comment: Made a perfect start over fences beating three rivals to win at Plumpton last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden hurdler but made a perfect start over fences beating three rivals to win at Plumpton (3m1f, good) last month aided by a first-time tongue-tie (retained); may well have more to offer off 2lb higher.

runners_data.name: Worth The Walk
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with recent placed form, 55-day break could leave her short of peak fitness

races.paceDynamic: The Clonmel Kid will likely set the pace with Katie's Melody, Kells Priory, Killybegs Jet Lady and Worth The Walk all showing prominent tendencies, creating a competitive early gallop over this 3-mile test. The sustained pace should stretch the field, with the hold-up horses Dr Shirocco, Don Brocco, West Lawn and Milan Milos needing to find their rhythm from off the pace. With multiple prominent runners and a stamina-sapping distance on good to soft ground, this race shape strongly favours horses that can travel kindly in the first half and have the tactical speed to strike when the pace inevitably slows. The prominent racers who can adapt their position hold the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves testing but sustainable, allowing the front division to control
scenarios.body: The pace-setters can dictate terms and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still getting organized. This tactical advantage proves decisive over the stamina-testing trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too hard early and tie up in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final half-mile, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Fresh legs triumph over tactical position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Killybegs Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the handicap weights level the playing field and course experience counts
scenarios.body: Her two runner-up efforts over course and distance give her the tactical knowledge to time her challenge perfectly. The 0-15 record finally ends with ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If The Clonmel Kid goes off too fast and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The early pace proves unsustainable, creating a messy finish where any horse with a late kick can capitalise. Form goes out the window in a tactical lottery.

watchPoints.text: The Clonmel Kid going too fast early - if he sets a fierce gallop he could stop quickly and compromise the entire pace scenario
Katie's Melody's jumping on chase debut - any mistakes could end her chances and potentially bring down others in the prominent group
Milan Milos and the tongue-tie effect - his Plumpton win came with this first-time aid so retaining it suggests connections expect another bold show
Killybegs Jet Lady's 3lb claimer Alan Doyle in a competitive handicap chase - any tactical errors could cost her breakthrough moment
The going changes through the card - if it rides slower than advertised it will further favour the prominent runners over hold-up horses

races.name: Northumberland County Show Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bold Step
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from powerful Henderson stable making hurdles debut after promising bumper form, with James Bowen's 130-day break suggesting a planned campaign.
runners_data.comment: Promising bumper debut, should be suited by going up in trip on hurdle debut; key player.
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Kincardine (bumper/2m hurdle) and Steal A March (useful 2m5f-3m hurdler); made a promising debut when runner-up in an Exeter bumper in January, shaping as though this longer trip will suit now switching to hurdles; respected.

runners_data.name: Mister St Eloi
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity with unproven running style and concerning 443-day absence, though Olly Murphy's recent form and Sean Bowen booking suggests confidence.
runners_data.comment: £180,000 buy after finishing second in an Irish point in March last year; respected.
runners_data.spotlight: Still in contention when hampered/unseating late on debut in Irish point and only narrowly denied by a subsequent hurdle winner on his second start in March last year, and later sold for £180,000; has not been seen since but is of clear interest if ready to go on rules/stable debut after a long absence.

runners_data.name: Coniston Commander
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist stepping up in trip which should suit his patient style, with solid bumper form and Nicky Richards' 58-day break indicating readiness.
runners_data.comment: Likely to make an impact over hurdles in time, but others make more immediate appeal.
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with promise in both his bumpers, and he's likely to be suited by this step up in trip now switching to hurdles; however, there are a couple who appear to have stronger credentials on this occasion.

runners_data.name: Rachel Lopez
runners_data.note: Confirmed hold-up runner with modest ability but recent 17-length course second suggests some competence at this level despite weak trainer form.
runners_data.comment: Bred to be suited by this longer trip but likely more is needed in this company.
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish; modest form in points and well beaten in a bumper; hard to gauge what she actually achieved when a 17l second to a long odds-on favourite over 2m here 10 days ago; bred to be suited by this longer distance but more likely needed in this company.

runners_data.name: Passing Diamond
runners_data.note: Natural front runner in career-best form following recent course win, but faces 163lbs top weight after his confidence-boosting victory 17 days ago.
runners_data.comment: Has a penalty to shoulder but likely there's more to come now back up in trip.
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Irish point winner; showed marked improvement on what he'd previously achieved in three runs over hurdles when winning a maiden hurdle here over 2m this month, keeping on well; has to concede weight all round under a penalty, but his experience will help and it's likely there's more to come now going back up in trip.

races.paceDynamic: Passing Diamond will dictate from the front with his proven leading style, facing no obvious early pressure from this small field. Bold Step and potentially Mister St Eloi will track in behind, while hold-up horses Coniston Commander and Rachel Lopez settle towards the rear. The uncontested lead will create a steady, sustainable gallop that builds gradually through the race. This moderate early pace strongly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalise on a strong finish when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Passing Diamond sets his usual steady tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The patient riders get ideal positioning as the pace builds late, allowing the class horses to showcase their finishing kicks. Coniston Commander and potentially Rachel Lopez benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Bold Step or Mister St Eloi apply early pressure to Passing Diamond
scenarios.body: The increased early pace stretches the field and suits the horses with tactical speed who can track the leaders closely. These prominent runners can kick clear before the hold-up horses get organised.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Passing Diamond gets completely uncontested fractions and maintains his recent form peak
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage through steady sectionals and kicks clear when challenged. His recent course win gives him confidence to repeat the performance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If all runners settle and nobody wants the lead early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where pure class and finishing speed determine the outcome regardless of running style. The most talented horse on the day wins from any position.

watchPoints.text: Mister St Eloi's fitness after 443 days off and whether he shows any early pace or settles as expected given his unknown running style.
Bold Step's jumping on hurdles debut and whether the 130-day break affects his early positioning behind the likely leader Passing Diamond.
Passing Diamond's ability to sustain his front-running style under top weight against this field after his recent exertions.
Coniston Commander's jumping fluency on hurdles debut and whether Danny McMenamin can get him into contention from his hold-up style.
Rachel Lopez's positioning early and whether Sean Quinlan attempts to improve on her 17-length course second from 10 days ago.

races.name: Port Of Blyth Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Thewoodcorner
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for Henderson with progressive profile and strong recent form, ideally placed to press the leader
runners_data.comment: Progressive profile and latest Ffos Las win suggests he can improve again off 6lb higher.
runners_data.spotlight: Has a largely progressive profile since winning at Chepstow (2m, soft) in January and produced a personal best when landing a Ffos Las (2m4f, good to soft) handicap last month, keeping on well; 6lb rise will demand more again but his age allowance is a key factor and he remains open to further progress.

runners_data.name: Sunset Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse improving after break, good recent second suggests upward curve continuing
runners_data.comment: Likely to be in the mix but probably remains vulnerable for the win off this sort of mark.
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to build on an encouraging return over fences in November, but latest effort over hurdles following a break was a good step forward when a close second over C&D ten days ago; nudged up 3lb for that and yet to win in handicap company, which suggests she possibly remains on a tough enough mark.

runners_data.name: Balboa
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who justified support last time at Ayr, remains well treated on current mark
runners_data.comment: Capitalised on a reduced mark at Ayr last time and remains well treated despite 6lb rise.
runners_data.spotlight: Made the most of a reduced mark when justifying support and gaining a first win since 2023 when scoring at Ayr (2m4f, soft) last month; remains well treated on past form back up 6lb and likely to be in the mix again.

runners_data.name: Kilbarry Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling off higher marks since hat-trick, trainer change adds uncertainty
runners_data.comment: Completed hat-trick in 2024 but has struggled since; dangerous if revived by new yard.
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick in late 2024 (including a walkover) but has largely struggled off higher marks since and signed off for Olly Murphy with a couple of modest efforts, including in cheekpieces last time; 3lb lower than for his latest success but needs the change of scenery to spark a revival.

runners_data.name: Red Cadillac
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with excellent record on soft ground, 74 days off ring rust concern
runners_data.comment: Progressive since November and latest win suggests he can be competitive off 8lb higher.
runners_data.spotlight: Came good with hard-fought success on his reappearance at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) in November and has improved on that in two Ayr outings since, upped to around this trip and winning on soft last time; up 8lb which demands another career best but he has to be respected in current form.

runners_data.name: That One
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who made all here last April but both hurdle runs since have disappointed
runners_data.comment: Made all here last April and 2nd in h'cap next time; has to recapture that initial form.
runners_data.spotlight: Made all to win a 2m novice hurdle here last April and follow-up effort when runner-up in a handicap at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) was promising; however, both hurdling efforts since haven't been so good and he was a mid-race faller on last month's chase debut; should stay this far and he's on a competitive mark if recapturing initial promise.

runners_data.name: Double Digits
runners_data.note: Lone front-runner whose tactical advantage is crucial, though stamina over this trip unproven under rules
runners_data.comment: Reliable 8yo; recent hurdle runs encouraging and 3m point win offers hope for this trip.
runners_data.spotlight: Largely reliable 8yo both over hurdles and fences and recent efforts in this sphere offer plenty of hope; has yet to convince he needs this far under rules though, but was a 3m soft-ground point winner and is hard to rule out should he confirm his stamina.

runners_data.name: Well Educated
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on dangerous low weight but 206 days absence and poor recent form major concerns
runners_data.comment: Four-time course winner but out of form recently and needs to turn things around.
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time winner here, two over C&D on good ground (handles soft); undoubtedly on a dangerous mark but latest two efforts have been underwhelming and he needs to turn things around; safer to look elsewhere on recent form.

runners_data.name: Wee Alki
runners_data.note: Prominent racer thriving recently but 7lb claimer and quick reappearance after 3m effort may tell
runners_data.comment: Doubled hurdle score here latest and thriving, but 6lb rise over shorter trip asks more.
runners_data.spotlight: Doubled his hurdle tally over nearly 3m here 17 days ago, but that wasn't coming out of turn after a couple of solid placed efforts; he's thriving but peak efforts have been over further and the 6lb rise asks a question.

runners_data.name: Banderas
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with mixed form, tongue-tie added suggests connections seeking improvement
runners_data.comment: Promising recent return here and interesting back up in trip if building on that effort.
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Southwell maiden hurdle (2m4f, good; first-time tongue-tie) and a Carlisle Flat handicap (2m1f, soft) last summer, but handicap hurdle debut in September was too bad to be true; however, he made a promising return here over 2m 17 days ago when shaping as though he'd improve for the outing; interesting back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Terrorise
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 356-day absence with visor first time, huge fitness concern
runners_data.comment: Dual Flat winner; hurdle win at Cartmel but recent Flat form tempers enthusiasm; visored.
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Flat winner (1m2f/2m); highly tried on hurdles debut last April but showed an aptitude for the game when third at Market Rasen (extended 2m, good) in May and went on to land a hard-fought Cartmel success later that month; now handicapping with potential and could have more to offer up in trip, though recent Flat form tempers enthusiasm; wears a first-time visor.

runners_data.name: Divilabother
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner closely matched with Wee Alki on recent form, trip drop back should suit
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; fair form since and closely matched with Wee Alki, respected back in trip.
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner on stable debut in August and mainly fair form since; closely matched with Wee Alki on their clash over 3m here 17 days ago and the drop back in trip is maybe more in his favour; respected.

runners_data.name: Born Like Me
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 7lb claimer whose remote last on handicap debut leaves much to prove
runners_data.comment: Showed ability in maidens but well beaten on handicap debut and has plenty to prove.
runners_data.spotlight: Has hinted at ability but he finished a remote last in December on handicap debut at Catterick (2m4f, good), which leaves him with plenty to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Double Digits provides the only confirmed front-running presence in this 13-runner field, with Thewoodcorner and Wee Alki likely to press from prominent positions early. The lack of pace pressure should allow Double Digits to dictate terms and set a sustainable gallop over this staying trip on testing ground. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics, the race sets up perfectly for those who can travel closer to the pace and have the stamina to grind out the finish. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers and front-runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Double Digits gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can utilise his tactical advantage and proven stamina to repel late challenges on ground that will sap finishing kicks. His ability to dictate from the front becomes crucial when the hold-up brigade get in each other's way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Thewoodcorner or Wee Alki press Double Digits from the outset
scenarios.body: The increased pace will set up the race for those tracking just behind the leaders who can strike at the ideal moment. Henderson's Thewoodcorner has the class and progressive profile to time his challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: One of the better hold-up horses can overcome traffic issues and produce a strong late surge. Balboa's recent Ayr win suggests he can capitalise if getting a clear passage late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or interference creates an unconventional race shape
scenarios.body: The disruption allows a moderate hold-up horse to inherit a winning position through fortune rather than merit. Well Educated's course experience could prove decisive if others encounter trouble.

watchPoints.text: Double Digits must be monitored closely in the betting - any significant support would confirm the front-running advantage is live
Watch for any non-runners as this would reduce the traffic problems facing the hold-up horses significantly
Thewoodcorner's market position will reveal Henderson's confidence in this progressive sort stepping up in class
Ground conditions on the day - any further softening would enhance Double Digits' tactical edge further
Early pace development crucial - if Thewoodcorner or Wee Alki fail to press Double Digits the race becomes easier for the leader

races.name: Jason Arnup After Party 6th June Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Allbetsoff
runners_data.note: Front-runner with two course and distance wins but 170 days off and 10 years old raising stamina concerns
runners_data.comment: Second in this race on stable debut a year ago but lost way afterwards; back from break
runners_data.spotlight: Gained two of his five hurdle wins over C&D and was second off mark 7lb higher than today's when making stable debut in this race a year ago (good); lost his way afterwards, though, and absent since heavy fall in November.

runners_data.name: Western Soldier
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good form but stable running poorly at 2/9 in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Not much has gone to plan since his quite stylish Wincanton win in November
runners_data.spotlight: Scored in pretty good style at Wincanton (1m7f, good) in November and today's 4lb higher mark is probably workable but not much has gone to plan since and he arrives here with a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Fine Point
runners_data.note: Prominent racer building on improved form with first-time cheekpieces showing promise last time
runners_data.comment: Ran big race before weakening into third at Kelso last month, his second stable start
runners_data.spotlight: Built upon satisfactory stable debut and ran big race before weakening into third at Kelso (2m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) last month; remains on a good mark and should cope with the forecast slower ground here; likely contender.

runners_data.name: Blue Bear
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 7-pound claimer reducing weight to competitive 148lbs
runners_data.comment: Penultimate run arrested his decline but he was soundly beaten last time
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well for a long way and seemed to have arrested his decline when fourth at Market Rasen (2m4f, good) last month but was soundly beaten over that C&D 11 days ago and now has questions to answer again; drops back in trip with hood removed after one use.

runners_data.name: Interchangeable
runners_data.note: Back-marker aided by hood and tongue-tie combination when third at Kelso last time
runners_data.comment: 0-5 for current stable but dropped another 3lb since last month's respectable Kelso third
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 for current stable since the autumn but seemingly aided by refitted hood and/or first-time tongue-tie when respectable third at Kelso (2m2f, good) last month and has dropped another 3lb since.

runners_data.name: Justus
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed better form last time but generally inconsistent this season
runners_data.comment: Latest run was step in right direction but he was generally very disappointing last term
runners_data.spotlight: Took big step back in right direction and arguably ran better than bare form suggests when fifth at Wetherby (2m, good to soft) in March, but was generally very disappointing last season; others have more appealing profiles.

runners_data.name: Fairly Fulling
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse coming off maiden hurdle win but rising 7lbs for that Newcastle success
runners_data.comment: Came good over 2m4f at Newcastle in March, his 14th hurdle start; 7lb rise demands more
runners_data.spotlight: Came good over hurdles at 14th attempt, with clear success at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in March; should be okay back at 2m on this stiff track but 7lb rise demands more from him.

runners_data.name: Malangen
runners_data.note: Front-runner in good recent form, just ran well at Perth six days ago under similar conditions
runners_data.comment: Reeled in after blasting off in front at Perth on Wednesday but kept on gamely for second
runners_data.spotlight: Returned to form at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) on Wednesday, when he was reeled in after blasting off in front but kept on gamely for second; also suited by this C&D and a recent 2lb drop has now taken effect but he had a hard race at Perth and has become inconsistent.

runners_data.name: King Kodiak
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with mixed record but showed front-running ability when third at Carlisle
runners_data.comment: Clumsy jumper with very mixed hurdling record; ran big race two starts ago, though
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles; has a very mixed record and is sometimes a clumsy jumper but made a bold bid from the front when third at Carlisle (2m3f, good to soft) two runs ago and can't be ruled out; tongue tied for first time.

runners_data.name: Am I Bovvered
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who races too freely and was well beaten when trying this trip last time
runners_data.comment: Not beaten that far on handicap debut (2m5f); well beaten over 3m since; now back at 2m
runners_data.spotlight: Not beaten that far when sixth of eight on last month's handicap debut at Kelso (2m5f, good) but raced too freely (not for the first time) and was well beaten when upped to 3m at Perth three weeks later; drops back to 2m here; others look safer.

races.paceDynamic: Allbetsoff and Malangen will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners having natural pace. Allbetsoff has won twice over course and distance from the front, while Malangen showed his front-running intent at Perth just six days ago. This dual pace angle will create an honest gallop from flag to finish, with the leaders likely to go hard early before one or both come back to the field. The strong early pace clearly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers who can pick up the pieces, as the front-runners will soften each other up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Allbetsoff and Malangen go too hard early and both weaken significantly
scenarios.body: The pace duel burns out the leaders leaving the race wide open for closers to sweep up. Hold-up horses like Western Soldier, Blue Bear and Interchangeable get the perfect setup to unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If either Allbetsoff or Malangen gets the better of their pace duel and stays on
scenarios.body: The survivor of the early battle has enough left to hold off late challenges on this stiff track. Malangen's recent Perth run suggests he can handle a hard race, while Allbetsoff has the course form advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Fine Point or Justus can sit just behind the leaders without getting caught up in the pace
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get the perfect trip tracking the leaders before striking at the ideal moment. Fine Point's recent third at Kelso showed improved form, while Justus has the class when right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow early or one pulls up/falls
scenarios.body: A messy race develops where the pace scenarios fall apart entirely. This creates a tactical lottery where any horse with a bit of class can capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Malangen could be vulnerable having raced just six days ago at Perth after a hard front-running effort
Blue Bear's 7-pound claiming jockey Oscar Palmer may struggle to position this hold-up horse effectively in a strongly-run race
Allbetsoff's jumping could deteriorate after 170 days off, especially if pressured early by Malangen
Fine Point's first-time cheekpieces worked well last time so any headgear removal would be significant
Western Soldier needs the pace to collapse but his trainer Seamus Mullins is running at poor strike-rate recently
